issue_context.title: [OPTIMIZATION] Introduce tag estimation for lag calculation
issue_context.body:
Currently, if the consumer subscribes to a topic with a tag filter, the lag is not very accurate, especially since messages with this tag are infrequent. So I want to introduce tag estimation for lag calculation: sampling the ratio of messages with this tag and multiplying the total lag by this ratio.

You can read [this blog (Chinese Ver.)](https://blog.lv5.moe/p/explanation-and-optimization-of-apache-rocketmq-lag) for information about more improvements in the lag calculation.

review_comments: Since there may be multiple messages in one BCQ index, IMO, It would be better to consider using the batch size field to estimate a more accurate value.
